The Blodgett House

Israel Blodgett, a blacksmith from Massachusetts, built the house in 1846 on what is now Maple Avenue. The family moved to Downers Grove in 1835.

According to family accounts, the Blodgetts sheltered freedom seekers travelling the Underground Railroad in the 1850s.

The house was moved to the museum campus in 2008 and restored by the Downers Grove Park District.
